nom: BLK/OPL Even True Deep Treatment Brightening Scrub

segments.oily: Two reviewers with oily skin (one oily/uneven, one with an oily T-zone) report the scrub evened skin tone and texture without increasing oiliness, and one notes it did not dry out her skin despite being a strong exfoliant.

concerns.spots: Three reviewers describe fading or lightening of dark spots and more even skin tone, including one who paired the scrub with a brightening day cream for the same purpose.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the scrub helps with blackhead issues when used 2-3 times a week.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily/uneven skin reports her skin became less oily after use, and another with an oily T-zone reports no negative effect on oiliness despite skepticism beforehand.

aspects.libelle: Skin feels smooth and soft after use
Product goes a long way, little needed
Suitable for frequent use, 3-4 times weekly
Works well on body areas like elbows and knees
Past packaging changes and stock outages

extraits.titre: Even True Deep Treatment Brightening Scrub
extraits.texte: I have oily and uneven skin but ever since I used this product my skin tone has even out so I don't have to wear as much makeup to cover up the dark spots. It also helps that with less makeup my skin is not as oily anymore. My skin actually looks like I have make-up on it because the tone and texture is so even. I'm sold!

extraits.titre: Even True Deep Treatment Brightening Scrub
extraits.texte: Great face scrub. You only need a little at a time, it goes a long way. I was skeptical at first cause I have an oily T-zone and although it was a scrub it is creamy and seems to have similar ingredients as the other facial products, which may have helped it's effectiveness on my skin because I used this in conjunction with the moisturizer and the crÌ¬me cleanser. I'm BO all the way!

extraits.titre: Even True Deep Treatment Brightening Scrub
extraits.texte: This scrub is a must have staple!! It has softened and smoothed my skin as well as lightened my dark spots. It is so gentle that I use it 3-4 times weekly as part of my cleansing regimen.

extraits.titre: Even True Deep Treatment Brightening Scrub
extraits.texte: Love, love this product. And it WORKS. I swear after using it once, instantly your face feels like a babies butt and has a bounce to it. I also use it with the brightening day cream for dark spots and uneven tones. I need more of this stuff. :)

extraits.titre: Even True Deep Treatment Brightening Scrub
extraits.texte: i love this product , i have used many different exfoliates this one by black opal has been the best so far its very strong but gental on my skin dosent leave my skin dry, after washing my face it looks so clean and clear i will use this product as long as black opal contiunes to sell it.

extraits.titre: Even True Deep Treatment Brightening Scrub
extraits.texte: I really like this scrub for black head issues. It should only be used about 2-3x a week though.
I love this product. this is my third purchase. It is wonderful for elbows and knees.

reserve: All 12 reviews are highly positive (4-5 stars) with no critical review available, and most give little detail on skin type beyond oily, so conclusions for other skin types cannot be drawn.
